text: Dependency-checked next bounded tranche: eco-u3-kernels (required Astra review now approved and started), eco-u3-consumers (full caller/fixture/buffer acceptance and deletion), eco-neuroatlas-volume (source review then publication/default-pin acceptance), eco-neuroim-display (optional slice scenes/platform hosts, no core display edge), eco-neuroim-integrations (caller migration and deletion after display/routing). Completing these five could close U3 and I1, reduce remaining implementation tasks19->14; closure requires actual evidence. Next pair thereafter: eco-u4-measurements + eco-u4-integrations. Do not include eco-neuroatlas-integrations yet: it still requires eco-neuroatlas-surface. User has approved Astra substitution, not a waiver of review/correctness requirements.
